items.atlasDescription: Timber from the lush worlds, cut green and stacked by the cartload. Every settlement begins with it, and every great project comes back to it.
items.iconConcept: A stout log lying on a diagonal with one round cut face showing three growth rings.

items.atlasDescription: Dense grey rock that rings when struck. It holds the foundations of everything and never runs out.
items.iconConcept: A rounded boulder with three visible faceted planes and a flat base.

items.atlasDescription: Wreckage and worn-out machinery lie on every world, because someone always got there first. Pressed, burned or melted, none of it is ever wasted.
items.iconConcept: A jagged torn metal plate with a single round bolt hole punched through it.

items.atlasDescription: Fast-growing fibrous growth, thick with sap and spores. It ferments into clean fuel and weaves into seals that shrug off poison.
items.iconConcept: A young sprout: two broad leaves flaring from a short curved stem.

items.atlasDescription: Rust-red ore heavy with metal, found in veins under volcanic crust and dry plains. Smelted, it becomes the skeleton of everything you build.
items.iconConcept: An angular trapezoid nugget crossed by one bright diagonal vein.

items.atlasDescription: Green-streaked ore that conducts better than anything else you can dig up. Drawn into wire, it carries every signal and every current.
items.iconConcept: A cluster of three round bubbly lobes, like a bunch of grapes, flecked with teal.

items.atlasDescription: Fine quartz sand from the dry basins and crystal flats. Melted it turns to glass, and ground it polishes lenses.
items.iconConcept: A conical heap of sand with a rippled crest and a few loose grains around the base.

items.atlasDescription: Hard blue ice cut from glaciers, comet shells and shadowed craters. It holds the cold that cryogenic hulls and quantum lattices depend on.
items.iconConcept: A tilted rounded cube with a chipped corner and a curved glint across one face.

items.atlasDescription: Grey ore so dense it blunts ordinary drills. Refined, it turns light, strong and unbothered by fire or vacuum.
items.iconConcept: A squat six-sided nugget with a ridged band across its middle and two bright specks.

items.atlasDescription: Resonant crystal that hums when struck and glows when worked. It sharpens tools, focuses beams and stores more energy than it should.
items.iconConcept: A tall faceted spear of crystal flanked by two shorter shards.

items.atlasDescription: Pale gas siphoned from swamps, oceans and giant worlds. A little of it burns hotter than a hold full of wood.
items.iconConcept: A ball-and-stick molecule: one large dot joined by four spokes to four small dots.

items.atlasDescription: A rare light gas drifting in the storm bands of the giants. Ships crave it, and so does every quantum machine.
items.iconConcept: A round balloon with a small knot at the bottom and a curling string.

items.atlasDescription: A pulsing organic knot torn from alien hives and fallen raiders. Nobody agrees what it is, but every advanced machine runs better with one inside.
items.iconConcept: An almond-shaped eye with a vertical slit pupil, ringed by short thorns.

items.atlasDescription: A faintly glowing salt that ticks in the dark. Dangerous to carry, essential for shielding, and priceless to anyone who knows how to contain it.
items.iconConcept: A round hazard disc with three fan blades around a centre dot (the trefoil).

items.atlasDescription: A pocket of nothing that pulls on everything. Dug from the deepest shattered worlds, it is the last ingredient of the last machines.
items.iconConcept: A solid dark disc crossed by one thin offset orbit ellipse, like an eclipsed planet.

items.atlasDescription: Compact cells of refined energy that power every jump. Cooked from whatever burns: wood in the first days, gas and ice when the ship is bigger.
items.iconConcept: A squat cell with a small nub on top and a lightning bolt cut out of its body.

items.atlasDescription: Sawn timber cut to length. It frames the buildings of every era, and the late projects eat it by the thousand.
items.iconConcept: A stack of three flat boards, each offset a little, with a nail dot at the end.

items.atlasDescription: Rolled sheets of smelted iron, still warm from the foundry. The first real building material of any colony.
items.iconConcept: A thick flat slab drawn as a parallelogram with a round rivet in each corner.

items.atlasDescription: Copper drawn thin and wound on spools. Everything with a pulse, from a lamp to a reactor, needs a length of it.
items.iconConcept: A round spool wound with turns of wire, one loose end trailing off to the right.

items.atlasDescription: Clear, hard panes melted from silica. They keep out the weather, hold the vacuum and become lenses when polished.
items.iconConcept: A tall upright window pane with a plus-shaped cross frame and one diagonal glint.

items.atlasDescription: Pressed titanium cut into light, stubborn armor panels. It survives heat that melts steel and cold that shatters it.
items.iconConcept: A rectangle with chamfered corners and one raised X-shaped brace stamped across it.

items.atlasDescription: Iron hardened with the carbon of burnt timber. The backbone of tools, turrets and hulls.
items.iconConcept: An I-beam seen end-on: two wide flanges joined by a thin web.

items.atlasDescription: Plant fibre pressed with resin into a flexible, self-sealing skin. Toxic air eats steel but slides off this.
items.iconConcept: A pointed leaf-shaped plate with a centre rib and a faint cross-hatch weave.

items.atlasDescription: Titanium and glass fused into a ceramic-bright metal that glows without failing. Hulls plated with it can land where rock still flows.
items.iconConcept: A trapezoid ingot with three wavy heat-shimmer lines rising above it.

items.atlasDescription: A foam-cored laminate that keeps its strength far below freezing. It lets a ship set down where the air itself is ice.
items.iconConcept: A hexagonal tile with six small triangular frost notches and a dot at its centre.

items.atlasDescription: Layered steel and radium-laced glass that drinks hard radiation. Shielding like this opens the worlds that glow in the dark.
items.iconConcept: A heater-shield outline cut into three horizontal bands, like layers of lead.

items.atlasDescription: A black metal grown around a seed of dark matter. It bends light and survives where space itself is thin.
items.iconConcept: A dark diamond with a bright dot at its centre and a thin offset outline around it.

items.atlasDescription: Etched copper on a glass-fibre sheet. Every control, sensor and drone starts with one.
items.iconConcept: A rectangle with three L-shaped traces ending in round pads and one square chip.

items.atlasDescription: A sealed motor with a precision gearhead. It moves every arm, drill carriage and turret in the colony.
items.iconConcept: A squat cylinder carrying a short shaft topped with a six-tooth cog.

items.atlasDescription: A ground and polished lens, flawless enough to focus a laser or read a star. Scanners and turrets are blind without it.
items.iconConcept: A bi-convex lens shape with a bright crescent glint inside a thin mounting ring.

items.atlasDescription: A lattice of cooled helium and etched crystal that computes in more than one state at once. Navigation and research run on it.
items.iconConcept: A small square chip with pin rows on all four sides and a glowing diamond die in the middle.

items.atlasDescription: A superconducting coil wound around a speck of dark matter. Charge it and space folds; it is the last part of every great ship.
items.iconConcept: A donut-shaped ring wound from five loops of coil with a bright spark at its centre.

items.atlasDescription: A magnetic bottle of superheated gas that carries eight times the energy of a fuel cell. It lets a deep run fit in a few slots.
items.iconConcept: A round-bottomed flask with a flat neck and an S-shaped swirl of flame inside.

items.atlasDescription: A pod of trapped antiparticles in a mirrored field. Sixty-four cells of energy in a package you can hold, and a carelessness you cannot survive.
items.iconConcept: A pill-shaped capsule with a bright centre band, a zigzag seam and a pin at each end.
